title: SPOTTED BY THE OVERSEER
why: His note of 2026-10-12: change Spotted by something huge to Spotted by the Overseer. That callout fired for any warden that saw you, and every raid also has a plain Warden besides THE OVERSEER. Now THE OVERSEER seeing you says SPOTTED BY THE OVERSEER, and a plain Warden says SPOTTED BY A WARDEN, so the plain one never claims to be the boss. In co-op the host tells your teammate which one it was, so his window shows the same line.
now: THE OVERSEER seeing you now calls SPOTTED BY THE OVERSEER, and a plain Warden calls SPOTTED BY A WARDEN.
